t: Milwaukee Shockwave 1/4" Hex Shank PZ3 Impact Screwdriver Bits are engineered for professional use with impact drivers, providing a robust solution for heavy-duty drilling and fastening. These 25mm bits are ideal for electricians, plumbers, and general builders tackling demanding construction and renovation projects. Featuring Wear Guard Tip technology, they offer improved wear resistance and maintain a precise fit over time. The optimised Shockzone geometry flexes to absorb impacts, reducing stress at the tip and minimising breakages. Manufactured from custom-engineered steel, these Milwaukee bits deliver increased resistance to shock from high-torque impact driving.
